output.title: pac package deploy
steps_to_reproduce: Provision a UDE-linked F&O environment via Power Platform Admin Center (no LCS project).

Build an X++ model with custom table/field extensions in Visual Studio 2022 (Unified Developer Experience tooling). Confirm the model deploys successfully via **Extensions → Dynamics 365 → Deploy → Deploy Models to Online Environment** in Visual Studio (this path works correctly and is not affected by this bug).

Create a Dataverse "Package Deployer" project (`pac package init`) and add the X++ deployable package as an external package: `pac package add-external-package --package-type xpp --path <deployable-package.zip>`.
Build the project (`dotnet build`) to produce the package DLL and `PkgAssets/ImportConfig.xml`.

Ensure the referenced zip is a correctly-formed Power Platform Unified Package (containing `fnomoduledefinition.json` at the root plus the compiled model folder) — produced via the official Azure Pipelines `XppCreatePackage@3` task with `CreateCloudPackage: true`.
Authenticate: `pac auth create --environment <env-url>`.
Run: `pac package deploy --package <path-to-package.dll> --logConsole --verbose`.
output.expected_result: The deployment should complete successfully.
output.actual_result: The `pac package deploy` command hangs indefinitely, deadlocking the process. The main thread blocks forever on an internal `ManualResetEventSlim.Wait()` inside `pac`'s own deployment code, waiting for a signal that is never sent. All other threads in the process are completely idle.
